basics.name: Plamen Mitev
basics.label: Front-End Developer (Web & Interactive Applications)
basics.summary: Front-End Developer specializing in JavaScript, TypeScript, and high-performance UI engineering. Experienced in building interactive applications, scalable component systems, and optimized rendering pipelines using modern frameworks such as React, Svelte, Pixi.js, and GSAP. Proven ability to deliver smooth, responsive user experiences in demanding environments. Actively seeking a fully remote front-end role.

work.name: Evolution
work.summary: Developing high-performance front-end systems for interactive web applications using TypeScript, Pixi.js, GSAP, and WebGL-based rendering.
highlights: Built complex UI flows, state-driven systems, and reusable components for large-scale interactive products.
Optimized rendering pipelines and asset loading, reducing load times and improving runtime performance.
Engineered animation systems using GSAP to deliver smooth, responsive, and visually consistent user experiences.
Collaborated with designers and product teams to implement polished, user-focused interfaces.

work.name: Wiener Games
work.summary: Developed interactive web applications using TypeScript, Cocos Creator, Pixi.js, and Spine.
highlights: Implemented core application logic, UI components, and reusable modules across multiple projects.
Optimized update loops, asset loading, and transitions to improve performance and responsiveness.
Built scalable UI systems and animation flows for interactive web experiences.

work.name: Spark Networks
work.summary: Developed high-traffic landing pages and web platforms using React, Svelte, TypeScript, and PHP.
highlights: Implemented performance improvements that significantly boosted PageSpeed scores and user retention.
Designed and developed reusable components and architectural improvements to reduce technical debt.
Mentored junior developers and established best practices for SEO, accessibility, and web performance.

work.name: Alokai (Altagram)
work.summary: Developed a SaaS platform for managing localization workflows using React and TypeScript.
highlights: Converted complex design wireframes into reusable, scalable React components.
Collaborated with product teams to implement features for internal management tools.

work.name: Altagram
